title: [main] Align G/L Register Posting Date with released schema
summary: The G/L Register table schema in W1 is updated to match the released 29.x version by adding field 10700 'Posting Date' with a secondary key, resolving AppSourceCop validation issues.
key_points: Adds field 10700 'Posting Date' (Date type with ClosingDates) to W1's G/L Register table
Creates a secondary key matching the released schema to align with baseline 29.2.58359.0
Preserves ES's existing active Posting Date functionality and APAC's WHT fields
No field population or backfill occurs; the change only adds the schema definition
Resolves AppSourceCop AS0002 validation error without schema deletions or obsoletion
quote: Align main with released 29.x G/L Register schema to address AppSourceCop AS0002.
